row.title: Evidence branch commits must hold only the ledger
row.body: The failure-audit evidence push failed because its commit sat on main and so carried a workflow-file change, which a GitHub App token refuses. The commit is now built with plumbing and holds only ops/failure-audit.jsonl. A detector whose command is not routed in foundation/__main__.py is now a finding (staticcontent and slawatch were unroutable).

title: Evidence branch commits must hold only the ledger
